prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Create a single square head-and-shoulders avatar portrait of THE SAME REAL PERSON shown in the two reference photos. Image 2 (casual glasses photo) is the primary appearance reference: preserve his face shape, proportions, eye shape and color, nose, lips, light moustache and chin stubble, short brown hair swept to the side, and black browline glasses with thin metal lower rims. Image 1 is a supporting reference for facial structure, not the phone or composition. Strong recognizable likeness to the reference person is the highest priority. Black crewneck shirt, relaxed subtle expression, centered face and full hair visible with margin for circular crop, shoulders shown. Simple unobtrusive background. Remove phone/hands and room clutter. Do not borrow the invented curly-haired character from earlier images. No heavy beard, no round glasses, no text, logos, watermarks, panels. Style/medium: Bold ink comic portrait with crisp expressive linework, restrained flat color and halftone shading. Keep real face proportions.
